plain_english: In proof merged, by Śiva-step-shining-glory-force — body-breath-made, measured-made-knower-standing-formed. When time's cadre reaches Your dissolution-step — then the goddess who shines, mine — she would be Śiva-made.
sanskrit_cite: pramāṇe saṃlīne śivapadalasadvaibhavavaśāt | tadā devī yāsau lasati mama sā syāc chivamayī
